title: Does Context Matter? CONTEXTUALJUDGEBENCH for Evaluating LLM-based Judges in Contextual Settings
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a technical benchmark (ContextualJudgeBench) to evaluate the performance of LLM judges based on criteria like faithfulness, completeness, and conciseness in retrieval-augmented generation and summarization tasks. It does not involve the evaluation of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
